channel.title: Covering Katy News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Covering Katy News (coveringkaty.com)

item.title: Cinco Ranch HOA asks residents to bury visible utility lines by March 1
item.description: The Cinco Ranch Homeowners Association is asking residents to have all visible utility lines on their properties buried by March 1, 2026, as part of ongoing efforts to maintain the safety and appearance of the community.

item.title: Katy Rodeo Parade closes annual Katy ISD FFA Livestock Show and Rodeo
item.description: The Katy Rodeo Parade took place Saturday marking the end of the annual Katy ISD FFA Livestock Show and Rodeo.

item.title: Olive Garden, Whataburger, Chase Bank Coming to Texas Heritage Marketplace Near Katy
item.description: Olive Garden, Whataburger and Chase Bank have finalized ground leases for the Texas Heritage Marketplace, a $400 million regional development under construction in Waller County near Katy.

item.title: Katy and Richmond Child Predator Sentenced to 25 Years for Sexual Abuse of Young Child
item.description: A Dominican immigrant who sexually abused a child in the Katy and Richmond areas has been sentenced to 25 years in prison. Jason Alfred Sanderson, 39, pleaded guilty Feb. 2 to continuous sexual abuse of a young child.

item.title: Early Voting Times and Locations for Katy's three counties
item.description: Early voting in Texas starts today, Feb. 17, 2027 and runs through Feb 27. The Katy area is spread across Fort Bend, Harris and Waller Counties. The times and locations for each county's early voting is located below.

item.title: Katy ISD FFA Auction Sets Record $1.2 Million at 2026 Livestock Show and Rodeo
item.description: Katy ISD FFA students reached new heights at the 2026 Katy ISD Livestock Show and Rodeo, as the annual livestock auction generated a record-setting $1.2 million in student support — the highest total in event history.

item.title: Race underway for three open Katy City Council seats
item.description: Three incumbent Katy City Council members are departing due to term limits. Eight candidates have filed in an effort to take their place.

item.title: Nine candidates file to run for Katy School Board
item.description: The May 2 Katy ISD school board election will feature eight candidates, but no incumbents.

item.title: Podcast's Phony Claims Fuel McFarlane's Continued Campaign Assault on JJ Clemence
item.description: A Hispanic Fort Bend County employee was stunned to learn that a man billed as an expert on Chinese government spies had identified him as a high-ranking Chinese Communist Party official on a local podcast.

item.title: Man arrested for Attempted Child Enticement in Cinco Ranch
item.description: A 70-year-old Katy man was arrested Wednesday after allegedly approaching a child and asking her to get into his vehicle in the Canyon Gate neighborhood in Cinco Ranch, according to Fort Bend County Precinct 1 Constable's Office.
